name: KoalaKite
tagline: A browser extension that screenshots periodically and alerts parents when AI classifies content as harmful.

awards: GitHub: “Ship It” — Best Use of GitHub

problem: Young people are increasingly exposed to harmful content online.
solution: Captures the active tab every few seconds and classifies it with Gemini vision into safety categories, notifying parents.
demo_moment: Team-described: open an unsafe page and see a parent alert.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “GitHub: “Ship It” — Best Use of GitHub” among 112 submissions.
Won by showing disciplined GitHub practice.

lessons: Process prizes reward issues, pull requests and releases, not features.
